ينفتح (form VII)
# يَنْفَتِحُ (yanfatiḥu) /jan.fa.ti.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# يَنْفَتِحَ (yanfatiḥa) /jan.fa.ti.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# يَنْفَتِحْ (yanfatiḥ) /jan.fa.tiħ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
